provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Me and my body
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify body parts
The pupils should be able to state what their body can do
Introduction:
We have been learning about ourselves
Today we learn about our body
Content:
Point to head, tummy, hands and feet
My body can see, hear and touch
We use our eyes to see
We use our ears to hear
We use our hands to touch
Class activity:
Let's touch our head then our feet
Let's touch our tummy then our hands
Evaluation questions:
What can you see in the classroom
What can you hear outside
What does your hand feel
Summary:
Our body helps us do many things
We must care for our body

topics.title: My five senses
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name the five senses
The pupils should be able to match senses to body parts
Introduction:
Last week we learned about our body
Today we learn how our body works
Content:
Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells
Tongue tastes, skin feels
Our eyes help us see colours
Our ears help us hear sounds
Our nose helps us smell good food
Our tongue helps us taste sweet or sour
Our skin helps us feel hot or cold
Class activity:
Let's close our eyes and listen
What sounds do you hear
Evaluation questions:
Which part helps you see
Which part helps you smell
What can your skin feel
Summary:
We have five senses to help us
They help us know the world

topics.title: Colours around us
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name four colours
The pupils should be able to find colours in the classroom
Introduction:
We use our eyes to see things
Today we learn about colours
Content:
Name red, blue, yellow and green
Find colours in class
Red like ripe tomatoes
Blue like the sky
Yellow like ripe plantain
Green like leaves
We see colours everywhere
Class activity:
Let's stand up when I say a colour
Find something red in the room
Evaluation questions:
What colour is the sky
What colour is a banana
What colour is grass
Summary:
Colours make our world beautiful
We see many colours every day

topics.title: Water play
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that water flows
The pupils should be able to tell wet from dry
Introduction:
We drink water every day
Today we play with water
Content:
Water flows and fills
Wet and dry sand
Water moves from one place to another
Water fills containers
Wet things feel different from dry things
Class activity:
Let's pour water from cup to cup
Let's make sand wet and dry
Evaluation questions:
What happens when you pour water
What does wet sand feel like
What does dry sand feel like
Summary:
Water flows and fills spaces
Things can be wet or dry

topics.title: Big and little animals
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name a big animal
The pupils should be able to name a small animal
Introduction:
Animals live with us
Today we learn about big and small animals
Content:
Name a big animal and a small one
Animal sounds
A cow is big
A rat is small
Big animals make loud sounds
Small animals make soft sounds
Class activity:
Let's move like big animals
Let's move like small animals
Evaluation questions:
Name a big animal
Name a small animal
What sound does a dog make
Summary:
Animals come in different sizes
Some are big some are small

topics.title: Pets
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name three pets
The pupils should be able to say why we keep pets
Introduction:\Some animals live with us
Today we learn about pets
Content:
Name the dog, cat and bird
Animals we keep at home
A dog is a good friend
A cat catches rats
A bird sings sweet songs
We keep pets for fun and help
Class activity:
Let's pretend to be pets
How does a dog bark
Evaluation questions:
Name a pet we keep at home
What does a cat do
Why do people keep pets
Summary:
Pets are animals we love at home
They are part of our family

topics.title: Plants are alive
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say plants need water
The pupils should be able to water a plant
Introduction:
Animals are alive
Today we learn about plants
Content:
A seed grows when we water it
Water the class plant
Plants need water to grow
Plants need sun to grow
Plants are alive like us
Class activity:
Let's water the class plant
Let's watch how plants grow
Evaluation questions:
What do plants need to grow
What happens to a seed with water
Are plants alive
Summary:
Plants are alive and need water
We must care for plants

topics.title: The sun and the sky
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say what the sun does
The pupils should be able to name things in the sky
Introduction:
We see the sky every day
Today we learn about the sun and sky
Content:
The sun gives light in the day
The moon and stars come at night
The sun is hot and bright
The moon is cool and white
Stars twinkle in the sky
Class activity:
Let's pretend to be the sun shining
Let's pretend to be stars twinkling
Evaluation questions:
What does the sun do in the day
What do we see at night
Is the sun hot or cold
Summary:
The sun gives light in the day
The moon and stars come at night

topics.title: Hot and cold
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to tell hot from cold
The pupils should be able to name hot and cold things
Introduction:
We feel different temperatures
Today we learn about hot and cold
Content:
Touch warm water and cool water
The sun is hot, ice is cold
Hot things can burn us
Cold things make us shiver
We feel hot in harmattan
Class activity:
Let's touch warm water then cool water
Let's rub our hands when cold
Evaluation questions:
What is hot
What is cold
What do we feel in harmattan
Summary:
Things can be hot or cold
We must be careful with hot things

topics.title: Revision and nature walk
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name things learned
The pupils should be able to collect nature items
Introduction:
We have learned many things
Today we revise and walk outside
Content:
Walk and name what we see
Collect leaves and stones
We see plants and animals
We see the sun and sky
We see many colours
Class activity:
Let's walk outside and name things
Let's collect leaves and stones
Evaluation questions:
What colour is the grass
What does the sun do
What sound do you hear
Summary:
Nature has many wonderful things
We must care for our nature
